title: Blue Mountain Beach "Drift Away on 30A" 35 Kriss Court
h1: Blue Mountain Beach "Drift Away on 30A" 35 Kriss Court
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Community pool and fitness center- 4 adult bikes- Screened-in porch- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Discover laid-back beach living at Drift Away on 30A, a beautiful 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom Blue Mountain Beach home that sleeps 8 in charming comfort. This Emerald Coast neighborhood is known for its natural beauty, funky atmosphere, and quintessential coastal fun. Peruse the local galleries for one-of-a-kind artwork, relax by the community pool, or spend an adventurous day paddling across the coastal dunes lakes. Guests will love this home’s convenient location—a half-mile from the famous Blue Mountain Beach Creamery and only a 13-minute stroll from beach access!A covered front porch with soft seating welcomes guests to this 3-level retreat. Step inside to find a light-filled entryway with hardwood floors and modern décor.A timeless staircase leads to the second-level great room, where natural elements evoke the calm of the coast and sumptuous fabrics add a luxe twist. Imagine sun-dappled mornings crafting breakfast in the open kitchen, boasting Café appliances, a 12-cup coffee maker, and a 2-seat breakfast bar for entertaining guests. The round table for 5 encourages gathering for lively dinner parties and friendly card games. After meals, curl up on the living space’s soft couch and 2 armchairs to enjoy a movie night on the 65” Smart TV. The primary bedroom is directly off the living space featuring a plush king bed and lavish private bathroom. Guests who prefer privacy will appreciate the guest bedroom with a king bed and private entrance down the hall. All the home’s bedrooms have Smart TVs for convenience, and this level also features a washer and dryer in the hall bathroom.Additional sleeping accommodations await on the top level, including a peaceful guest bedroom with a comfy queen bed and a kid-friendly bunk room with a twin-over-twin bed. The third-floor screened-in porch features cushioned wicker furniture and sprawling views—savor morning coffee or sunset cocktails above the treetops.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 8):FIRST FLOOR:- Office Space with Half BathroomSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Blue Mountain Beach "Drift Away on 30A" 35 Kriss Court Santa Rosa Beach, FL Bedrooms 4 Beds 5 Sleeps 8 Full Baths 3 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Community pool and fitness center - 4 adult bikes - Screened-in porch - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Discover laid-back beach living at Drift Away on 30A, a beautiful 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom Blue Mountain Beach home that sleeps 8 in charming comfort. This Emerald Coast neighborhood is known for its natural beauty, funky atmosphere, and quintessential coastal fun. Peruse the local galleries for one-of-a-kind artwork, relax by the community pool, or spend an adventurous day paddling across the coastal dunes lakes. Guests will love this home’s convenient location—a half-mile from the famous Blue Mountain Beach Creamery and only a 13-minute stroll from beach access! A covered front porch with soft seating welcomes guests to this 3-level retreat. Step inside to find a light-filled entryway with hardwood floors and modern décor. A timeless staircase leads to the second-level great room, where natural elements evoke the calm of the coast and sumptuous fabrics add a luxe twist. Imagine sun-dappled mornings crafting breakfast in the open kitchen, boasting Café appliances, a 12-cup coffee maker, and a 2-seat breakfast bar for entertaining guests. The round table for 5 encourages gathering for lively dinner parties and friendly card games. After meals, curl up on the living space’s soft couch and 2 armchairs to enjoy a movie night on the 65” Smart TV. The primary bedroom is directly off the living space featuring a plush king bed and lavish private bathroom. Guests who prefer privacy will appreciate the guest bedroom with a king bed and private entrance down the hall. All the home’s bedrooms have Smart TVs for convenience, and this level also features a washer and dryer in the hall bathroom. Additional sleeping accommodations await on the top level, including a peaceful guest bedroom with a comfy queen bed and a kid-friendly bunk room with a twin-over-twin bed. The third-floor screened-in porch features cushioned wicker furniture and sprawling views—savor morning coffee or sunset cocktails above the treetops. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.
